reuse.why: Hooks into the existing shared linkBankAccount entry point that every provider-specific link function delegates to, following the pattern of the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked guard.

duplication.why: Adds one small guard with no repeated logic.

placement.why: The guard sits in server/accounts/app.ts next to the other pre-link assertion and runs before any bank, account or sync-server work.

scope.why: Only the new guard and its one call are added.

maintainability.why: A named assertion called at the single chokepoint for all providers is easy to read and to extend.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All provider link functions go through linkBankAccount, where the check is made.

one_place.where: assertAccountNotClosed called once at the top of linkBankAccount in server/accounts/app.ts, which every provider-specific link path uses.
